usage: llm-modelbench serve [-h] --runs-dir RUNS_DIR [--port PORT]
                            [--host HOST] [--allow-remote] [--allow-empty]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR  repeatable finished run directory
  --port PORT
  --host HOST
  --allow-remote       permit binding outside loopback; exposes model/routing
                       metadata on the network
  --allow-empty        start even when no valid summary.json artifacts were
                       loaded
